title: Restaurant (hospitality)
$comment: G6-5 (APR-JE-046, D-P4-2): the first industry adapter. It holds what only a restaurant site has: its JSON-LD type and fields, its configuration schemas (menu, copy) and its component contracts (dish, menu category, hours, owner note, steps). The base engineering asks the adapter; it never names a restaurant. A project of another industry declares its own adapter (or none) and the same base checks run.
